description: Scrape a public webpage for AI agents: convert a web page URL into markdown, HTML, links or images, with optional JavaScript rendering and AI extraction or summary. Supports web content retrieval for research and RAG; response format follows the requested options. Price: 1-25 prepaid credits per successful call. This tool returns markdown; use REST for other formats or AI extraction.

challenge_mode.description: For pages that answer with a browser verification check. 10 credits; not combinable with premium or render_js.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of markdown characters to return.

premium.description: Premium mode (10 credits): retry with this when a page comes back blocked or empty.

render_js.description: Whether to render the page with JavaScript before scraping.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS page URL to scrape.
